title: Commit a group send in one transaction
description: chinwag (chinwag-dxgx.28) runs SQLite with synchronous=NORMAL: a power cut or OS crash can lose the last few seconds of committed messages. synchronous=FULL makes group bursts about 3x slower, because a group send makes one backend write per recipient and each write is its own commit. If jmap-chat-server's backend trait let one group send (the Message plus its per-member deliveries) be written as one unit, a backend could commit it once, and chinwag could run FULL at roughly today's speed. Mark chose (2026-10-30): keep NORMAL in chinwag now, and file this here.
